MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "A Fool To Care feels like a natural next choice because I enjoyed Memphis and want more of Boz Scaggs's soulful blues vocals.",
    "Santana IV and Let Me Get By fit the guitar-led blues and rock interest reflected in my listening to Old Sock and People, Hell & Angels."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "To All The Girls... misses my mood because a country duet collection does not offer the blues sound I want today.",
    "Givin' It Up leans toward jazz-oriented vocals, while the live acoustic albums offer a different listening experience from the studio album I am choosing now.",
    "World Famous Headliners is too unfamiliar for me to choose during a quick visit; a possible musical fit alone is not enough to draw me in."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The choices seem to treat familiar rock, country, and jazz performers as similarly appealing, although soulful blues is the stronger connection for me today.",
    "An interest in guitar music seems to carry over too broadly to atmospheric rock and live acoustic performances, which are less compelling for this visit."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My connection to Memphis makes another Boz Scaggs album especially appealing, beyond a general resemblance to other music I have played.",
    "Today's preference for soulful vocals and a studio recording matters when choosing among otherwise appealing blues and guitar albums.",
    "With little time to explore, I need a clear connection to something I already enjoy before trying an unfamiliar name."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my blues and guitar interests, but spread too widely beyond the familiar, soulful studio sound I want today."
}
